description: fluvgeo is an R package for fluvial geomorphology analysis. Its repository documents functions that calculate stream channel and planform dimensions, produce reports and support bankfull-elevation choices for ungauged streams. It is designed to work with a separate FluvialGeomorph ArcGIS toolbox that extracts spatial values from high-resolution terrain. Users supply channel surveys or processed geometry; outputs are quantitative reach measures and reports for the selected river. Geographic coverage follows the user's river sites. The README states CC0 licensing and identifies the project as active. A limitation is that channel geometry alone does not predict a flood hydrograph or future erosion; the terrain source, bankfull assumption and reach stability must be checked. fluvgeo can prepare cross-sections for drainage, bridge or flood-defence simulation. The related catalogue EPANET record is a pipe-network simulator, not river morphology software. No terrain data or R package was downloaded.
